name: 40-text-overflow
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } div { width: 170px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; border: 1px solid #999; margin: 8px 0; font-size: 14px; } .clip { text-overflow: clip; } .wrap { white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
html:
省略号：这一行文字明显超出一百七十像素的盒子宽度
裁切：同样超宽的文本被直接切断
允许换行：white-space normal 加 overflow-wrap，长串 ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ 也会在必要时断开。
